## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `adopt` entries make the command print each adoption message twice, because the unchanged `run` loop renders them after `plan` has already emitted them; this should be fixed.

## Changes
`plan` now appends an `adopt` entry for each setting already present and a trailing `audit` entry carrying the incoming setting count. Two added tests assert the audit entry for a one-setting and an empty plan.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop run() emitting each adoption twice — `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` emits "Adopted theme" twice: the `adopt` entry appended here is rendered again by the loop at `app/cli.py:9`, which skips only `audit`. `plan` already emits that message at `app/planner.py:8`. — Command users see every adopted setting reported twice, and no test calls `run` with an existing setting. — Fix: Skip `adopt` alongside `audit` in the filter at `app/cli.py:7` (the direct emit at `app/planner.py:8` is required by `test_adoption_progress`), and add a `run` adoption case to `tests/test_planner.py`.
